verdict.rationale: Lovable documents a first-party Settings → Plans & credit usage page where users can see their credit balance, track usage, add credits and manage top-ups. It also confirms a free plan exists. However, nothing in the evidence explains how many credits each action consumes or what each plan includes. Missing for 10: per-action credit cost documentation, plan-by-plan inclusion details, independent or hands-on corroboration of how clear the usage tracking is.

support.subject: As a founder, I can understand what credits or tokens each action consumes and what my plan includes

citations.quote: Use Settings → Plans & credit usage to understand your credit balance, track credit usage, add credits, and manage top-ups.
Lovable automatically creates your first personal workspace on the free plan
